name: class-control
description: Instructor desktop app for Class Control lab management

scripts.dist: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win --x64
scripts.student: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/electron/cli.js electron/student.js
scripts.dist:student: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --config electron-builder.student.cjs --win --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:student:mac: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --config electron-builder.student.cjs --mac --publish never
